description: This file defines the declaration of the TextReader class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes constructors, a destructor, assignment operator, and methods for resetting the reader, checking end of text, and reading lines, along with private members for index and data block.

classes.name: TextReader
classes.description: A class for reading text data from a DataElement, with functionality to read lines, reset position, and check for end of text.

methods.name: TextReader()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing index to zero and data block to default.

methods.name: TextReader(DataElement& element, const uint32_t offset = 0)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a DataElement reference and optional offset.

methods.name: operator=(const TextReader& rhs)
methods.description: Assignment operator copying index and data block.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the reading position to the beginning.

methods.name: EndOfText()
methods.description: Checks if the end of the text has been reached.

methods.name: ReadLine()
methods.description: Reads a line of text from the data block.
